resources.string: This month\'s spending, category pie and quick cash entry

Only when you open a wallet app you checked in Ledgerly (e.g. JKO, Easy Wallet), reads the merchant, amount and date on its transaction page and imports them. It also reads notification text as a backup for notification auto-recording (used when Android 15 hides content from the notification listener); only apps you enabled there are recorded. Data stays on your phone.
